title: Unit economics: add reconciliation report vs billing totals (daily + monthly)
author: Mei Lin
description: Adds a reconciliation report and warehouse view that compares the Unit Economics pipeline aggregates (blended $/1M output tokens and underlying $ + tokens) against billing totals for the same time window. This is intended as a Finance sign-off tool and a recurring data quality guardrail for exec reporting (QTD/MTD). The report is internal-only and intentionally conservative about what it claims to reconcile: we reconcile compute-related cost attribution and token-metered usage to billing line items that are attributable to inference usage; we explicitly exclude taxes, one-time fees, manual adjustments, and contract-specific true-ups that are not represented in metering. Implementation overview: (1) introduces a canonical reconciliation window definition (UTC by default, with a documented option to run in Finance reporting TZ), (2) materializes daily and monthly reconciliation tables keyed by customer_tier + region + model_family (optional drilldown) and a top-level rollup, (3) implements tolerance-based pass/fail gates with reason codes (e.g., missing metering hours, rate-card version mismatch, billing lag), and (4) wires a lightweight CLI + scheduled job to publish a daily snapshot and a CSV export for FP&A. Guardrails: we hard-fail the report if metering completeness is below threshold (see econ_pipeline_completeness_pct), if the billing extract is missing the last N hours for the requested window, or if the GPU rate card version differs from the one pinned for the window; we soft-warn for low-volume segments where rounding dominates. Known limitations (documented in the report header and README): refunds/credits are applied at invoice time and may land outside the usage window; dedicated/private contracts often bill at committed capacity rather than metered tokens (we still provide a reconciliation section, but it is labeled "not expected to match" unless contract flags indicate usage-based billing); resellers can aggregate billing across multiple internal org_ids; and streaming output token parity issues can bias the token side if a regression occurs (this report surfaces the discrepancy but does not correct it). Testing: added unit tests for billing line-item classification, window alignment, tolerance math, and reason-code prioritization; added an end-to-end test with a fixture billing export and a fixture metering aggregate for a known-good day. Rollout: behind internal feature flag UNIT_ECON_RECONCILIATION_REPORT; Finance (Laura/Rishi) requested this as a go/no-go artifact for v1; once merged we will run in shadow mode for 1 week and tune tolerances before gating the exec KPI pack.

reconcile: compute deltas, pct deltas, and reason codes with tolerance policy
cli: add `rw econ reconcile` export (csv + json) and scheduled snapshot job
tests: add fixtures + reconciliation math tests; docs: add limitations + runbook link
checklist: [x] Explicit inclusion/exclusion rules for billing line items
[x] Reason codes for mismatches (actionable for oncall + Finance)

conversation: Logan Wright (review): The direction looks right. Two questions: (1) can you make the reconciliation window alignment explicit (billing extracts often come in local time), and (2) do we have a hard stop when metering completeness is below SLO? Right now it looks like a warning only.

Mei Lin (author): Added `window_timezone` handling with UTC default + docs. Also changed completeness from warn->fail if below 99.5% for the window; the failure reason code is `METERING_INCOMPLETE` and includes missing_hours + affected dimensions.

Rishi Malhotra (review): Please call out that invoice credits/refunds will not reconcile within the same day and can drift MTD, otherwise FP&A will get paged. Also: can we pin rate card version per window so we can re-run historical reconciliation even after rate card updates?

Mei Lin (author): Updated report header and README with a prominent limitation section (credits/refunds, timing). Added `rate_card_version` column and the job now requires a pinned version for the window; if not provided, it uses the version active at window end and marks `RATE_CARD_UNPINNED` as a warning (Finance asked for hard pinning for exec numbers).

Laura Bennett (review): Inclusion/exclusion looks correct. One request: make sure "billing totals" excludes taxes and one-time fees by default; we only want usage-based inference revenue/cost comparables here. Also please add a CSV export format that matches the KPI pack ingestion expectations (columns + naming).

Mei Lin (author): Default classifier now excludes TAX/FEES/ONE_TIME and anything tagged "manual_adjustment". Added `--format kpi-pack-csv` option that outputs the exact column set Rishi sent (day, window_tz, billed_usd, attributed_usd, delta_usd, delta_pct, reason_code, notes).

Chloe Martin (review): From Console side this will eventually power a "Reconciliation" tab. Can we keep the schema stable and avoid customer_id exposure? Also, please ensure the view is performant (no full scan for MTD queries).

Mei Lin (author): Schema uses only tier/region/model_family and does not include customer identifiers. For perf, the daily view is partitioned by day and materialized; monthly view aggregates from daily partitions. Added query plan notes in the doc.

Caleb Johnson (review): Reason-code prioritization: if billing lag AND metering incomplete, which one wins? For oncall triage we should surface metering first (we control it) but keep both in the notes field.

Mei Lin (author): Updated prioritization order to: METERING_INCOMPLETE > DIMENSION_COVERAGE_DROP > BILLING_LAG > RATE_CARD_MISMATCH > ROUNDING_LOW_VOLUME. We still append all detected flags into `notes` for context.
Logan Wright (final): Approved. Please run shadow mode for a week and post the daily deltas in #finance once we have a baseline tolerance tuned.
Mei Lin (author): Will do. Shadow-mode schedule set for 07:00 UTC daily; outputs land in `econ_reconciliation_snapshots` and CSVs go to the Finance shared drive path documented in the README.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Logan Wright
release_notes: Internal: Added reconciliation report vs billing totals for Unit Economics pipeline; provides daily/monthly deltas, reason codes, and CSV export for FP&A. Behind UNIT_ECON_RECONCILIATION_REPORT feature flag.
notes: Follow-ups: tune tolerance thresholds after 1 week shadow run; consider separate handling for Dedicated/Private contract billing models (expected non-match); wire this into the Unit Economics dashboard as a health widget once schema stabilizes.
